doc: Marks the next free slot D_80081554 (masked to 0-15) as occupied in the D_80083D98 registration table, mirrors the slot index into D_80081558, then advances the D_80081554 counter and calls two no-arg helper leaves (func_8003528C, func_800352B4).

globals.name: D_80081554
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80081554; /* gp-rel 'next free slot' counter into D_80083D98; reset to 0 in func_8004DDB4; here masked with 0xF (so effectively 0-15 of the 32-slot table) then incremented by 1 each call */

globals.decl: extern s32 D_80081558; /* gp-rel mirror of the (masked) slot index written by this function; reset alongside D_80081554 in func_8004DDB4 */

globals.name: D_80083D98
